Q0.answer:
SELECT 
    e.EmployeeID,
    e.FirstName,
    COUNT(o.OrderID) AS TotalOrdersHandled
FROM Employees e
LEFT JOIN Orders o
    ON e.EmployeeID = o.EmployeeID
GROUP BY 
    e.EmployeeID, 
    e.FirstName
ORDER BY 
    e.EmployeeID;

Q1.answer:
SELECT 
    CategoryID,
    MIN(UnitPrice) AS MinUnitPrice
FROM Products
GROUP BY CategoryID
ORDER BY CategoryID;

Q2.answer:
SELECT DISTINCT CompanyName
FROM Suppliers s
JOIN Products p ON s.SupplierID = p.SupplierID
WHERE p.UnitPrice > 100;

Q3.answer: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table';

Q4.answer:
SELECT 
    Title,
    COUNT(*) AS EmployeeCount
FROM Employees
GROUP BY Title
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

Q7.answer:
SELECT 
    CompanyName,
    Country
FROM Customers
WHERE Country IN ('USA', 'UK', 'France');

Q8.answer:
SELECT 
    ProductName,
    UnitPrice
FROM Products
ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC
LIMIT 5;
